name: My Time with You
source:
A childhood love has returned after years of waiting for her, rekindling your hopes of being with her. But another woman who claims to be your 'wife' from the future has come to save you from an unknown 'horror?' that lies ahead. Together with her, you will change your future for the better(or not), through the choices you make. You'll meet a colorful cast of characters that will affect you shaping your life as you influence theirs with the choices "you" will make and hopefully not get your balls bashed in trying to nail them all.

[From [url=https://eolostudios.itch.io/my-time-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
等待多年的青梅竹马终于回到你身边，重新点燃了你与她相守的希望。然而，另一名自称是来自未来的“妻子”的女人也出现了，想要救你脱离前方未知的“恐怖事件”？你将与她一起，通过自己的选择改变未来，使其变得更好（也可能更糟）。你会遇见一群个性鲜明的角色，你的选择会影响他们、塑造你的人生，而你也会影响他们的人生。希望你在试图把她们全都追到手时，不会被人踢爆蛋蛋。

[来源：[url=https://eolostudios.itch.io/my-time-with-you]Itch.io[/url]]
